title: IssueProgramWebLinkCallablePayload
description: Mint a signed, expiring web link for someone without a Catch account: a driver's trip (subjectId = tripId), a vendor's run sheet (subjectId = vendorId), a hotel front desk's rooming list and guest IDs (hotelHandover, subjectId = hotelId), the hotel porters' hamper list (hamperPorter, subjectId = hotelId) or the family's counts-only view (family, subjectId = programId). Minting writes nothing; the token carries only ids and an expiry.
